schema.sharedShape: 以下の各キーは、いずれも同じ形をとります。

glossary.$comment-conformance-claim: conformance claim stays 適合性の宣言 so it pairs with 宣言レベル for claimed level; the WCAG 2.1 ja translation renders it 適合表明 (https://waic.jp/translations/WCAG21/).
glossary.$comment-federation: federation stays フェデレーション; MDN ja uses 連合 only for identity federation (https://developer.mozilla.org/ja/docs/Web/API/FedCM_API), which is a different sense.
glossary.$comment-scaffold: scaffold stays スキャフォールド; Vue ja uses 雛形 (https://ja.vuejs.org/guide/scaling-up/tooling.html), a word these pages already use for boilerplate.
glossary.$comment-currency: currency has three senses on these pages. A record's currency is いつ時点のものか, the date it speaks for. Checkout currency and pin currency are 現在性, the property of matching the canonical source rather than the contents held. Checkout currency is glossed on its first use in a document; pin currency carries no gloss, because the English names no comparison basis there.
glossary.$comment-pin: pin has two senses the pages keep apart: the noun is the recorded revision, ピン, and the verb is ピン留めする. GitHub Docs ja writes ピン止め (https://docs.github.com/ja/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/administering-issues/pinning-an-issue-to-your-repository), an orthographic variant of the same word. The manifest key `pin` is never translated.
glossary.$comment-hydrate: hydrate is the verb, ハイドレート, and the noun is ハイドレーション, matching React ja (https://ja.react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot).
glossary.$comment-governance: governance stays ガバナンス; the 運営 of Open Source Guides ja (https://opensource.guide/ja/leadership-and-governance/) means day-to-day operation and would collide with the separate sense of operating.
glossary.$comment-steward: steward is glossed on its first use on a page, スチュワード（仕様の管理主体）, and bare after that, because bare スチュワード reads first as a cabin or ship steward.
glossary.$comment-redirect: redirect has two senses: 誘導 for pointing a reader or an agent at something, リダイレクト for the HTTP redirect (https://developer.mozilla.org/ja/docs/Web/HTTP/Guides/Redirections).
glossary.$comment-circle: circle is 輪, the circle of people (仲間の輪); 円 reads first as the geometric circle or the currency.
glossary.$comment-export: export is エクスポート, matching MDN ja (https://developer.mozilla.org/ja/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/export).
glossary.$comment-unused: informative (参考情報), trust boundary (信頼境界) and single-sourced (単一の出典で管理された) are settled renderings that no page uses today; they are kept so a page that needs them has one.
